description: This file contains a PHP class 'Returns' that extends the core Model class. It defines methods for fetching and counting report data related to product returns, including filtering by status, date range, grouping, and pagination.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling report data related to product returns in the admin extension.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records with filtering, grouping, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of return records based on filters and grouping.
